definitions.explanation: A proposed plan for fixing or improving an existing problem, process, or situation. Compound of {改善|かいぜん} (improvement) + {案|あん} (proposal, draft).

examples.japanese: {改善案|かいぜんあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: I think up an improvement proposal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{改善案|かいぜんあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We invited improvement proposals from the employees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現状|げんじょう}→現状：02721_genjou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題点|もんだいてん}→問題点：20619_mondaiten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}した→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧うえ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{改善案|かいぜんあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: After sorting out the problems with the current situation, I put together an improvement proposal.

notes:
A proposal aimed at correcting a problem or making an existing process, product, or workflow better. Common in business and quality-management contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {改善案|かいぜんあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧・⟦{提案|ていあん}する→提案する：06057_teiansuru⟧: to put forward an improvement proposal
- {改善案|かいぜんあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧: to compile an improvement plan
- {改善案|かいぜんあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}する→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧: to consider an improvement proposal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{企画案|きかくあん}→企画案：27963_kikakuan⟧: project proposal — proposes something new, rather than fixing what exists
- ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: countermeasure — focuses on dealing with a specific problem
